fields.statement: Built rhiza at 04cd35f (go build -o $TMPDIR/rhiza ./cmd/rhiza) and ran the built-in review workflow with rhiza run start --workflow review --permission-mode manual in hermetic scratch repos (own HOME and git config; fake rex running the pane command, fake claude acting each role) on a built two-leaf change set where quality's cycle-1 major on leaf alpha is confirmed. Fixer exits 1 on its first session: cycle 2 ran fixer, fixer, verifier, then quality check 2; journal leaf-attempt fixer 2 fail, fixer 3 pass, verifier 3 pass, all before the cycle-2 check session; quality passed after 2 cycles and the run reached sign-off. Verifier exits 1 on its first session: cycle 2 ran fixer, verifier, fixer, verifier (a fresh pair), then quality check 2; passed after 2 cycles, run at sign-off.

Same built binary and scratch setup as leaf-fix-retry-in-cycle-qa-1. Fixer exits 1 on every session of cycle 2: three fixers ran in cycle 2 (journal leaf-attempt fixer 2, 3, 4 all fail), no check session started in cycle 2, quality's cycle 2 was journalled failed with detail 'cycle 2: fix failed: leaf alpha: fixer failed: exit 1', and cycle 3 started a fresh first attempt (fixer 5 pass, verifier 5 pass) before quality check 3, which passed; run reached sign-off. Verifier exits 1 on every session of cycle 2: three fixer+verifier pairs ran in cycle 2, cycle 2 failed with 'cycle 2: fix failed: leaf alpha: verifier failed: exit 1', cycle 3 ran a fresh pair then quality check 3. Note: rhiza run status text shows only 'cycle 2: failed', without the detail.
